criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: The official 2023 oblique photo visibly supports a multi-level brick house and multiple steep gabled roof sections.
The model depicts two principal facade levels, repeated gables, and a taller arched entry bay; the reopened total height is 14.65 m.
findings: No measured height, floor plan, or elevation source is available; eaves, ridges, and entry tower heights remain visual estimates.
GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 is inconsistent with the photo's apparent multi-level facade; Extrution=36 has no documented unit or semantics. Do not infer either model height or story count from those fields.
The photo shows a stepped row of gabled wings, while the preview's roof masses and intersections remain simplified and are not dimensionally verified.

evidence: The source image supports brick walls, dark shingles, pale trim, a tall entry bay with arched upper glazing, and dark doors; the preview includes those broad features and repeated windows.
findings: In the photo, the tall arched entrance is at the near end of the visible long facade; in the preview it sits around two-thirds across the shown facade. The photo has no camera pose, so this mismatch is concerning but cannot be conclusively mapped to compass orientation.
The roof planes and intersections are blocky/simplified, and window rhythm is more regular than the visible source facade.
